"""Two actual pristine serve routes; LP5 is a diagnostic fingerprint, not full parity."""
import hashlib
import math
import re
from common import require

FAULT = re.compile(r'page fault|fault response|timestamp stuck|wedg|engine reset|gt reset|guc.*(?:timeout|timed out|failed)|device.*lost|Timed out wait for G2H|Check job timeout|Timedout job|Schedule disable failed|trying reset|\breset (?:queued|started|done)\b', re.I)
FATAL = re.compile(r'GPU completion unconfirmed|terminate called|Assertion .*failed|\[FATAL\]|asynchronous.*(?:error|exception)|UR_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST|ZE_RESULT_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST', re.I)
COMPILE = re.compile(r'CL_BUILD_PROGRAM_FAILURE|(?:UR|ZE)_RESULT_ERROR_(?:PROGRAM_BUILD_FAILURE|MODULE_BUILD_FAILURE|INVALID_KERNEL|INVALID_BINARY|INVALID_WORK_GROUP_SIZE|INVALID_WORK_ITEM_SIZE)|kernel.*(?:unsupported|not supported|compil)|SPIR-V|build log|invalid work.group size', re.I)
ERROR = re.compile(r'UR_RESULT_ERROR_[A-Z_]+|ZE_RESULT_ERROR_[A-Z_]+|\[ERROR\]|\bCAT error\b|out of resources', re.I)


BUILD_ENUMS = {'UR_RESULT_ERROR_PROGRAM_BUILD_FAILURE', 'ZE_RESULT_ERROR_MODULE_BUILD_FAILURE',
               'UR_RESULT_ERROR_PROGRAM_LINK_FAILURE', 'UR_RESULT_ERROR_INVALID_KERNEL',
               'UR_RESULT_ERROR_INVALID_BINARY', 'UR_RESULT_ERROR_INVALID_WORK_GROUP_SIZE',
               'UR_RESULT_ERROR_INVALID_WORK_ITEM_SIZE'}
ENUM = re.compile(r'\b(?:UR|ZE)_RESULT_ERROR_[A-Z_]+\b', re.I)


def diagnostics(text, *, startup=False):
    # Only individually enumerated build statuses can be reviewed at startup. A compile word
    # never excuses another runtime error enum, including another enum on the very same line.
    lines = text.splitlines()
    relevant = [s for s in lines if FAULT.search(s) or FATAL.search(s) or COMPILE.search(s) or ERROR.search(s)]
    require(sum(len(s.encode()) + 1 for s in relevant) <= 1 << 20, 'compact relevant diagnostics cap')
    severe, build = [], []
    for line in relevant:
        enums = {value.upper() for value in ENUM.findall(line)}
        only_build = bool(enums) and enums <= BUILD_ENUMS
        hard = bool(FAULT.search(line) or FATAL.search(line))
        plain_error = bool(re.search(r'\bCAT error\b|out of resources', line, re.I)) or (
            '[ERROR]' in line.upper() and not (startup and only_build))
        if hard or (enums and (not startup or not only_build)) or plain_error or (
                not startup and 'CL_BUILD_PROGRAM_FAILURE' in line.upper()):
            severe.append(line)
        elif only_build or COMPILE.search(line):
            build.append(line)
    return dict(relevant_messages=relevant, severe_messages=severe, compile_messages=build,
                stage='startup-reviewable-build-only' if startup else 'post-READY-strict',
                limitation='Startup known build enums require Main review. Every post-READY error enum/fatal fails, even beside compile text. Successful compile progress alone is not an error.')



class DiagnosticReader:
    """Incremental strict diagnostics, including a partial line across successive reads."""
    def __init__(self, offset):
        require(type(offset) is int and 0 <= offset <= 64 << 20, 'bounded diagnostic offset')
        self.offset = offset
        self.pending = b''

    def check(self, path):
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            stream.seek(self.offset)
            data = stream.read((64 << 20) + 1)
        require(self.offset + len(data) <= 64 << 20, 'bounded cumulative diagnostic read')
        self.offset += len(data)
        text = self.pending + data
        self.pending = text.rsplit(b'\n', 1)[-1]
        require(len(self.pending) <= 1 << 20, 'bounded partial diagnostic line')
        return diagnostics(text.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))


def info(startup, engine, extra):
    require(startup[-1].split() == ['READY', '262144', 'stop'], 'exact physical-context READY')
    lines = [s for s in startup if s.startswith('INFO ')]
    require(len(lines) == 1, 'one actual INFO')
    result = {}
    for word in lines[0].split()[1:]:
        require('=' in word, 'INFO key/value field')
        key, value = word.split('=', 1)
        require(key not in result, 'duplicate INFO field')
        result[key] = value
    slots = result.get('expert_slots', '')
    require(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', slots) and 0 < int(slots) <= 48 * 512,
            'actual positive integer expert slots within model population')
    expected = dict(context='262144', kv='int8', kv_resident='32768', spec='4' if engine == 'xe' else '8',
                    lookup='0', pool_workers='5', pcie_frac='0.00', conversation_cache_mib='0')
    require(all(k not in expected or str(v) == expected[k] for k, v in extra.items()), 'Main INFO cannot override fixed policy')
    expected.update(extra)
    require(all(result.get(k) == str(v) for k, v in expected.items()), 'actual effective fixed settings')
    require(int(result['vram_free_mib']) >= 512, 'READY free VRAM >=512MiB')
    require(result.get('batch_slots', '0') == '0', 'ordinary serial request only')
    return result


def validate(lines, engine, stderr, *, require_trace=True, expected_prompt_tokens=32768):
    n = expected_prompt_tokens
    require(type(n) is int and 32768 <= n <= 65536, 'bounded actual prompt geometry32768..65536')
    require(all(type(line) is str and len(line.encode()) <= 4096 for line in lines), 'bounded compact protocol fields')
    require(lines and all(type(x) is str and not x.startswith(('ERR', 'BDONE', 'B ')) for x in lines), 'no selected-path failure/batch protocol')
    allowed = ('RESUME ', 'PP ', 'REUSED ', 'T ', 'LP ', 'DONE ')
    require(all(x.startswith(allowed) for x in lines), 'only source-qualified GEN tags')
    require([x for x in lines if x.startswith('RESUME ')] == ['RESUME 0'] and
            [x for x in lines if x.startswith('REUSED ')] == ['REUSED 0'], 'fresh token0 request with no reuse')
    done = [x.split() for x in lines if x.startswith('DONE ')]
    require(len(done) == 1 and len(done[0]) == 16 and lines[-1].startswith('DONE '), 'one complete final DONE')
    d = done[0]
    require(int(d[1]) == 16 and int(d[2]) == n and int(d[14]) == n and int(d[8]) == 0 and
            d[5] == 'length' and list(map(int, d[6:8])) == [0, 0], 'full fresh GEN16, no draft/EOS truncation')
    require(all(math.isfinite(float(d[i])) and float(d[i]) > 0 for i in (3, 4)), 'finite positive engine samples')
    require(all(int(d[i]) >= 0 for i in (9, 10, 11, 12, 15)) and math.isfinite(float(d[13])) and float(d[13]) >= 0,
            'finite nonnegative tier accounting')
    pp = [x.split() for x in lines if x.startswith('PP ')]
    ends = list(range(8192, n - 1, 8192)) + [n - 1] if engine == 'xe' else [n - 1]
    require(all(len(x) == 5 for x in pp), 'complete PP fields')
    require([int(x[1]) for x in pp] == ends and all(len(x) == 5 and int(x[2]) == n and
            all(math.isfinite(float(v)) and float(v) >= 0 for v in x[3:]) for x in pp), 'actual full prompt route progress')
    require(len(lines) == 1 + len(ends) + 1 + 32 + 1 and lines[0] == 'RESUME 0' and
            lines[1 + len(ends)] == 'REUSED 0' and all(x.startswith('PP ') for x in lines[1:1 + len(ends)]),
            'strict fresh prompt/output phase ordering')
    output = [x for x in lines if x.startswith(('T ', 'LP '))]
    require(len(output) == 32, 'complete16 token/LP5 pairs')
    ids = []
    for i in range(16):
        token, lp = output[2 * i].split(), output[2 * i + 1].split()
        require(len(token) == 2 and token[0] == 'T' and 0 <= int(token[1]) < 248320, 'actual token domain/pair')
        require(len(lp) == 7 and lp[0] == 'LP' and math.isfinite(float(lp[1])), 'finite LP5')
        top = []
        for field in lp[2:]:
            tid, value = field.split(':')
            require(0 <= int(tid) < 248320 and math.isfinite(float(value)), 'LP5 vocabulary/value')
            top.append(int(tid))
        require(len(set(top)) == 5, 'distinct top5 IDs')
        ids.append(int(token[1]))
    chunks = re.findall(r'^strata trace: prompt chunk (\d+) of (\d+)$', stderr, re.M)
    reads = re.findall(r'^strata trace: read (\d+) tokens \((windows|batched)\) in ([0-9.]+) ms$', stderr, re.M)
    if not require_trace:
        require(not chunks and not reads, 'clean timed route has tracing disabled')
    elif engine == 'xe':
        require(chunks == [(str(start), str(n - 1)) for start in range(0, n - 1, 8192)] and
                len(reads) == 1 and reads[0][:2] == (str(n - 1), 'batched'), 'actual Xe all8192chunks through prompt n-1')
    else:
        require(not chunks and len(reads) == 1 and reads[0][:2] == (str(n - 1), 'windows'), 'official only serial read_windows, no batched route')
    require(all(math.isfinite(float(x[2])) and float(x[2]) >= 0 for x in reads), 'finite individual traced part sample')
    encoded = ('\n'.join(output) + '\n').encode()
    return dict(prompt_tokens=n, source_bound_prefill_chunks=(n - 2) // 8192 + 1 if engine == 'xe' else None,
                observed_prefill_chunks=len(chunks) if require_trace and engine == 'xe' else None, generated_tokens=16, finish='length', output_ids=ids,
                token_logprob_sha256=hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(), token_logprob_lines=output,
                engine_prefill_ms=float(d[3]), engine_decode_ms=float(d[4]), pp_samples=pp,
                individual_read_part_samples=[dict(tokens=int(a), route=b, ms=float(c)) for a, b, c in reads],
                actual_route=('batched8192' if engine == 'xe' else 'serial_read_windows8') if require_trace else None,
                source_bound_route='batched8192' if engine == 'xe' else 'serial_read_windows8',
                inferred_from_source=not require_trace,
                route_evidence_scope='observed debug trace' if require_trace else 'source-bound only; clean tracing absent',
                scope='Exact16 reported tokens/LP5 only; no full-logit, quality, RESTORE or optimal-speed claim')


def compare_pair(previous, current, previous_path, previous_sha):
    first, second = previous['phase'].rsplit('-', 1), current['phase'].rsplit('-', 1)
    require(first[0] == second[0] and {first[1], second[1]} == {'off', 'on'}, 'opposite arms in same pair')
    require(previous['input']['sha256'] == current['input']['sha256'], 'paired identical input')
    require(type(previous['input'].get('tokens')) is int and
            previous['input']['tokens'] == current['input'].get('tokens') and
            previous['validation']['prompt_tokens'] == current['validation']['prompt_tokens'] ==
            previous['input']['tokens'], 'paired identical actual prompt geometry')
    require(previous['environment'].get('STRATA_NAN_GUARD') == ('0' if first[1] == 'off' else '1') and
            current['environment'].get('STRATA_NAN_GUARD') == ('0' if second[1] == 'off' else '1'), 'actual guard arm')
    require({k: v for k, v in previous['environment'].items() if k != 'STRATA_NAN_GUARD'} ==
            {k: v for k, v in current['environment'].items() if k != 'STRATA_NAN_GUARD'},
            'paired environment equal except guard')
    off, on = (previous, current) if first[1] == 'off' else (current, previous)
    return dict(prompt_tokens=previous['input']['tokens'], previous_record=previous_path, previous_sha256=previous_sha, order=[previous['phase'], current['phase']],
                token_logprob_equal=off['validation']['token_logprob_sha256'] == on['validation']['token_logprob_sha256'],
                scope='16 generated tokens and reported LP5 only; no full-logit/full-quality claim',
                off_wall_samples=off['host_wall_samples'], on_wall_samples=on['host_wall_samples'],
                off_engine_prefill_ms=off['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'],
                on_engine_prefill_ms=on['validation']['engine_prefill_ms'],
                off_engine_decode_ms=off['validation']['engine_decode_ms'],
                on_engine_decode_ms=on['validation']['engine_decode_ms'])
